correctness.rationale: In the A_{m-1} incidence lattice the cycle edge vectors have the unique primitive linear relation sum_i s_i v_i=0, and any m-1 edges form a unimodular tree basis. For imbalance r=|p-q|>0 the vectors (v_i,1) generate an index-r sublattice, so Q_C is a full (m-1)-simplex of normalized volume r. The r fundamental-parallelepiped class representatives have heights 0,a+1,...,b-1, giving h*(Q_C)=1+sum_{k=a+1}^{b-1} t^k. For p=q the affine relation gives dimension m-2 and an oriented-circuit spanning-tree triangulation h*=sum_{k=0}^{a-1}t^k. Adding the origin gives a unimodular oriented-circuit triangulation of h*=sum_{k=0}^{b-1}t^k; in the balanced case a lattice pyramid. Checked the proof's integral index argument and read the actual verifier which checks exact determinants for every orientation through m=8; the all-m conclusions come from the primitive cycle relation, not finite enumeration.
